Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the necessary information from the search results. In Step 1, the agent successfully identified the Indianapolis 500 as a 500-mile race in May at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway. However, in Step 2 and subsequent steps, when instructed to search for "Are there any other Midwest tracks that host a 500-mile race in May besides Indianapolis Motor Speedway?", the agent repeatedly returned the exact same search results (DuckDuckGo results page showing RacingIn.com, Wikipedia, etc.) without actually visiting the linked pages (like the Wikipedia "List of IndyCar Series racetracks" or the specific track directories) to extract the data. The agent's output only contained the search query and the visible text of the search engine results page, which did not contain the specific answer to whether other tracks host such a race. This failure to navigate to and analyze the actual content of the search results led to an inability to confirm or deny the existence of other tracks, causing the conversation to loop indefinitely with the same incomplete information.
